+//! The staleness guard of the two recorded post inputs motion generates
+//! (#926): the bore-centre probe (`motion::probing::probe_cycle`) and the
+//! peck-drill cycle with a retract change (`motion::drilling::drill`),
+//! each dumped through `post::dump` and compared byte for byte with its
+//! file in `crates/post/tests/recorded/streams/`. The post's script suites
+//! read those files and never generate; this suite is what fails when the
+//! generator moves, so a recorded input cannot go stale silently. It lives
+//! in app because app is the one crate that sees both motion and post (no
+//! new crate edge, #919 Q4). The cl-built streams are guarded in post
+//! (`crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs`).
+//!
+//! Regenerate after an intentional generator change, then re-run the post
+//! script suites and read their golden diffs:
+//! `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test recorded_post_streams`
+//!
+//! Gate map (M4.4): covers motion::probing, motion::drilling, post::dump,
+//! post::cnc.
+
+use camcraft_app::drilling::{drill, CycleChoice, CycleParams, Hole};
+use camcraft_app::geo2d::Point2;
+use camcraft_app::geometry::Point3;
+use camcraft_app::post::{self, cnc, Dump};
+use camcraft_app::probing::{probe_cycle, ProbeDir, ProbeMode, ProbeParams};
+use camcraft_app::tools::{Tool, ToolKind};
+
+fn recorded(case: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
+    std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
+        .join("../post/tests/recorded/streams")
+        .join(format!("{case}.cnc"))
+}
+
+fn guard(case: &str, text: &str) {
+    let path = recorded(case);
+    if std::env::var_os("WRITE_GOLDEN").is_some() {
+        std::fs::write(&path, text).expect("write the recorded stream");
+        return;
+    }
+    let want = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {e}", path.display()));
+    assert_eq!(
+        want.replace("\r\n", "\n"),
+        text,
+        "recorded stream {} is stale: its generator writes something else now - regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1, then re-read every script golden it feeds",
+        path.display()
+    );
+}
+
+/// The bore centre of tests/probe_dialects.rs: a 20 mm bore at (30, 30),
+/// rim Z 20, four touches (seek + measure each); the result sets G55.
+fn probe() -> String {
+    let p = ProbeParams {
+        mode: ProbeMode::Bore,
+        dir: ProbeDir::ZNeg,
+        dir_y: ProbeDir::YPos,
+        target: Point3::new(30.0, 30.0, 20.0),
+        radius: 10.0,
+        ball_diameter: 4.0,
+        approach: 5.0,
+        overtravel: 5.0,
+        backoff: 1.0,
+        fast_feed: 300.0,
+        slow_feed: 30.0,
+        depth: 3.0,
+        inset: 5.0,
+        clearance_z: 50.0,
+    };
+    let t = probe_cycle(&p).expect("probe cycle");
+    let d = Dump {
+        op_name: "Probe1",
+        tool_number: 7,
+        tool_name: "PROBE-4",
+        tool_diameter: 4.0,
+        rpm: 0.0,
+        clearance_z: 50.0,
+        retract_z: 50.0,
+        wcs: "G54",
+        probe_result: Some(post::probe_rec::ProbeResult { set_wcs: Some(1), tol_mm: 0.5 }),
+        ..Dump::default()
+    };
+    let recs = post::dump(&t, &d);
+    assert!(!recs.iter().any(|r| matches!(r, cnc::Record::Warn { .. })), "a sane probe path carries no WARN");
+    cnc::serialize(&recs)
+}
+
+/// Two pecked holes with a retract change: the cycle's R plane is 1 mm
+/// over the part, the hop between holes 3 mm, the final retract the
+/// 10 mm clearance plane.
+fn drill_retract() -> String {
+    let tool = Tool {
+        kind: ToolKind::Drill,
+        diameter: 6.0,
+        corner_r: 0.0,
+        tip_angle: 118.0,
+        pitch: 0.0,
+        nose_radius: 0.0,
+        width: 0.0,
+        flute_len: 40.0,
+        shank_d: 6.0,
+        shank_len: 30.0,
+        holder_d: 20.0,
+        holder_len: 40.0,
+        material_group: String::from("steel"),
+        center_cutting: true,
+        rpm: 1500.0,
+        feed: 200.0,
+        tool_material: None,
+        flutes: None,
+        orientation: None,
+    };
+    let hole = |x: f64, floor_z: f64| Hole {
+        xy: Point2::new(x, 10.0),
+        radius: 3.0,
+        entry_z: 0.0,
+        floor_z,
+        through: false,
+        stepped: false,
+    };
+    let holes = [hole(10.0, -20.0), hole(30.0, -15.0)];
+    let p = CycleParams {
+        clearance_z: 10.0,
+        r_z: 1.0,
+        hop_z: Some(3.0),
+        bottom_z: None,
+        cycle: CycleChoice::Peck,
+        peck: 4.0,
+        dwell: 0.0,
+        feed: 200.0,
+        plunge_feed: 60.0,
+        tool: &tool,
+        holes: &holes,
+    };
+    let t = drill(&p).expect("drill cycle");
+    assert_eq!(t.cycles.len(), 2, "one cycle record per hole");
+    let d = Dump {
+        op_name: "Peck",
+        tool_number: 3,
+        tool_name: "DRILL-6",
+        tool_diameter: 6.0,
+        rpm: 1500.0,
+        clearance_z: 10.0,
+        retract_z: 3.0,
+        top_z: 0.0,
+        wcs: "G54",
+        ..Dump::default()
+    };
+    cnc::serialize(&post::dump(&t, &d))
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_stream_is_current() {
+    guard("probe", &probe());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn drill_retract_stream_is_current() {
+    guard("drill_retract", &drill_retract());
+}

+## #926 - recorded edge-case streams and one suite per post script (slice 1)
+
+**What was decided.**
+- Every shipped post script (`assets/posts/*.cps`) has a suite
+  `crates/post/tests/script_<stem>.rs` that runs the `post` binary
+  (`CARGO_BIN_EXE_post`, the maintainer's "tested against the post binary")
+  on nine recorded edge-case streams and compares the result with a golden
+  in `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/<stem>/`. One `#[test]` per case,
+  generated by the shared `post_suite!` macro in `recorded/mod.rs`, so a
+  failure names the post and the case.
+- A case's golden is either `<case>.nc` (the program the post released:
+  exit 0, no warning) or `<case>.refusal` (the named refusal: the counted
+  warnings the in-app gate blocks on, or the error the binary stopped on).
+  The refusal golden pins the refusal text, not the never-released program.
+- The recorded inputs are `.cnc` streams (`crates/post/tests/recorded/streams/`),
+  not toolpath-only `.cl` dumps: the `.cl` grammar carries no tool, spindle,
+  section, thread or probing records, and the cases need all of those. The
+  `.cnc` stream is the post's intermediate and a superset of `.cl`.
+- Cases: `arcs` (XY both senses, XZ, YZ split at its Z extremum, a helix),
+  `full_circle` (a ring as the generators write it, two halves),
+  `full_circle_raw` (one 360-degree arc record, hand-written - a foreign
+  producer could write it), `drill_retract` (pecked holes, R plane 1, hop 3,
+  clearance 10), `tool_change` (tool 1 forward, then tool 2 cutting a
+  left-hand thread toward -Z that needs M04), `rotary` (a 3+2 index, a move
+  that changes the lean, the commanded return upright; posted with
+  `assets/machines/tilthead.mch`, the only case with a machine), `probe`
+  (bore centre, sets G55), `empty_section`, `extreme_coords` (1 um moves, a
+  2 um arc, +-9999.999 and 99999.999 mm, F1 and F99999).
+- Staleness guards, each in the crate that can generate the input with no
+  new crate edge: `crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs` rebuilds the six
+  cl-built streams (cl `PathBuilder` + `post::dump`) byte for byte;
+  `crates/app/tests/recorded_post_streams.rs` rebuilds `probe`
+  (`motion::probing`) and `drill_retract` (`motion::drilling`) - app is the
+  one crate that sees motion and post. The hand-written `full_circle_raw`
+  is guarded by "parses, and the writer gives back the same text", plus the
+  presence of its 360-degree record. The post guard also fails when a
+  shipped `.cps` has no suite or the stream directory and the case list
+  disagree.
+
+**Why.** The maintainer's direction on #926. Running the binary rather than
+`engine::run` covers its machine door and its warning log the same way a user
+runs it. Guards on the generator side are what #926's body asks for.
+
+**Considered and dropped.**
+- A dev-dependency of post on motion (to generate probe/drill input inside
+  post): a new crate edge, which #926 forbids.
+- Guarding every stream in app: post-only changes (dump, writer) would then
+  need an app build to notice; the cl-built ones are guarded in post itself.
+- One golden per case holding both program and warnings: a refused program
+  is never released, so pinning its text would make refusals noisy to update.
+- Moving the ten existing app tests in this PR: slice 2 (see the PR).
+
+**Cost to change.** Adding a case: one builder + guard, one line in `CASES`
+and `post_suite!`, `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` for the 11 suites, then read 11 goldens.
